caption: The drawing shows a rectangular composition bordered by a thick blue and black frame. Inside, the main background consists of swirling patterns and large floral motifs in shades of pink, orange, and blue. In the center, there is a horizontal blue platform. On the left side of the platform, a black four-legged animal, possibly a horse or similar creature, is depicted in profile. To the right of the animal, there are three upright, cylindrical structures with blue, white, and black stripes and scalloped tops. Further right, a standing human figure is shown in front-facing profile, dressed in patterned clothing. Above the platform, there is a large blue padlock with a keyhole. The entire composition uses a limited color palette of blue, black, pink, orange, and white, highlighting geometric and decorative floral elements throughout the scene.
title: Chest Design
